entities.summary: The Comedy Theatre of Budapest is a theatre in Budapest. Starting in the late 19th century as an opposition to the conservative National Theatre, it became a pioneer institution of Hungarian drama, and one of the oldest theatres of the city still in operation. Comedy Theatre of Budapest is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1896. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
